name: TM7 Buttery Fruit Scones
ingredients: 150 g sultanas or mixed dried fruit
150 g whole milk, cold, plus a little extra for brushing

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C conventional / 200°C fan. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Add 450 g self-raising flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp fine salt and 100 g cold unsalted butter to the mixing bowl. Mix 10 sec / speed 6, until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.
Add 60 g caster sugar and mix 5 sec / speed 4.
Add 150 g sultanas or mixed dried fruit and mix 5 sec / reverse / speed 2.5.

ingredientLinks.match: 150 g sultanas or mixed dried fruit

steps.text: Add 2 large eggs, 150 g cold whole milk and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Mix 10 sec / reverse / speed 4. Then use Dough mode / 20 sec. The dough should be soft and slightly tacky. Do not overwork it.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured work surface. Bring it together gently with your hands without kneading. Pat out to about 3-3.5 cm thick.

Cut out 8-10 scones with a 6-7 cm round cutter, pressing straight down without twisting. Gently bring the scraps together and cut the remaining scones. Arrange on the prepared tray reasonably close together.
Lightly brush only the tops with a little extra milk, taking care not to let it run down the sides.
Bake at 200°C fan for 12-15 minutes, until well risen and golden brown on top with lightly golden bases.
Transfer to a wire rack. Serve slightly warm with salted butter, or with strawberry jam and clotted cream.
